Diana

Scorn of the Moon
Mid laneJungle lane

Diana jungle is a fast-clearing diver with Conqueror who ganks with a simple, deadly combo and wins teamfights with Moonfall. She builds tankier than mid Diana, so she can dive in and keep fighting. Pick her when your team needs a jungler who can engage on several enemies at once.

When to pick Diana

✓ Safe blind pick

Reasonably safe, but strong early duelists can invade her.

Pick into

  • Squishy junglers like Zed and Rengar
  • Teams that group in tight spaces around objectives
  • Lanes with immobile enemies she can gank

Avoid into

  • Strong early duelists like Kindred and Volibear
  • Fast farming junglers who out-scale her, like Shyvana
  • Heavy crowd control enemy teams

Great teammates

KatarinaKatarina resets through enemies Diana pulls together.
MalphiteTwo big area engages win teamfights.
XayahFeathers hit everyone Moonfall groups up.

Your team needs: Lanes with area damage and some follow-up crowd control.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Fast, healthy clears thanks to her cleave passive
  • Moonfall on several enemies wins teamfights and objective fights
  • Strong ganks after level 3 with Q-E
  • Bruiser build makes her harder to kill than mid Diana

Weaknesses

  • Weak to invades early by strong duelists
  • Ganks fail if Crescent Strike misses
  • Needs items to fight well; falling behind hurts
  • Crowd control stops her in the middle of the dive

Power spikes

  • Level 3: full combo for ganks
  • Level 6: Moonfall makes every gank and skirmish deadly
  • First item (Dusk and Dawn): sustained damage and attack speed for fights
  • Two items (Riftmaker): healing and damage for long fights
  • Three items (Zhonya's Hourglass): dive in, pull, then survive

Top tips

  • Start camps with W to save health
  • Gank lanes where the enemy is pushed and has no Flash
  • Throw Q from fog of war so it can't be dodged
  • Moonfall is best in tight spaces like the dragon and Baron pits
  • Use Smite only at the end of objectives
  • Track the enemy jungler and be on the other side of the map
